name: Gather
description:
Gather is the digital site diary for construction — contemporaneous records of shifts, labour, plant, progress, deliveries and weather, captured on site and structured for commercial use.

This connector gives Claude secure, read-only access to your Gather workspace. Ask plain-English questions of your project records and get evidence-backed answers: what happened on site last Tuesday, how many hours a subcontractor's gang worked this month, which activities have stalled, what the weather did to your programme in January. Claude can search narratives across thousands of diary entries, compare labour across periods, track progress quantities against plan, and summarise a project's records for reports, claims and reviews.

Every answer traces back to dated site records. The connector is read-only: Claude can never create, modify or delete anything in your Gather workspace.

Teams using Claude Code can additionally install the Gather plugin, which layers full quantity-surveying methodology on top of this connector — delay registers, NEC/JCT/FIDIC compensation event drafting, applications for payment, subcontractor verification and as-built programmes.

Requires a Gather account (gatherinsights.com).

_published_faq.name: How do I add Gather to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Gather to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.gatherinsights.com/public/api/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Gather MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gather provides these MCP tools: bulkGetAssets, calculateFatigue, getCachedReport, getMyProjects, getPeople, getProjectAssignments, getProjects, getReportSchemas, getShiftRecord, and getShiftRecords.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Gather?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Gather in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Gather requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Gather is developed by Gather. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
